Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence) para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de excelência de serviços do Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC).

Essa pessoa terá atuação estratégica, sendo responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e relevância dos indicadores utilizados na gestão da performance, ao mesmo tempo em que apoia a construção e evolução de métricas sempre que necessário.

  • Realizar interface com times de BI e dados para implementação das métricas;

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em atuação com stakeholders e áreas de negócio;

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para GTM Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Our Client

Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.

Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in.


The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and

product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue

team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount.

If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build.


What You'll Own

Outbound & Account Intelligence

  • Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers
  • Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch
  • Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack

Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence

  • Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand
  • Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)

Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics

  • Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing
  • Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings

Field & Event Activation

  • Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline
  • Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works

Internal AI Tooling

  • Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms
  • Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering



What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company
  • Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed
  • Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management
  • A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time

Strongly Preferred

  • Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast
  • Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical
  • Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration

You'll thrive here if you

  • Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority
  • Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc
  • Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked-
  • Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes

What Success Looks Like

  • By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher
  • By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling
  • By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Nuclear Projects Implementation Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Nuclear Projects Implementation Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring an Implementation Manager / Engineer  to support customer implementations for a SaaS platform used in complex operational environments.


This role is focused on implementations for a major U.S.-based nuclear energy customer. The ideal candidate has direct experience supporting implementation projects connected to nuclear power plants, nuclear facilities, nuclear energy operations, or nuclear engineering environments . 


This is a customer-facing role that requires strong project execution, technical coordination, documentation discipline, and the ability to manage implementation work in a highly regulated, safety-sensitive environment. 


The right candidate will be comfortable coordinating business, operational, engineering, technical, and vendor stakeholders while ensuring that implementation milestones, documentation, testing, rollout, and handover are completed with clarity and control. 


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead customer implementation projects from kickoff through deployment and operational handover.  
  • Coordinate implementation timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and status reporting.  
  • Serve as a primary point of contact during customer implementation phases.  
  • Work directly with customer operational, technical, engineering, and project stakeholders.  
  • Support implementation activities connected to nuclear power plant or nuclear energy environments.  
  • Manage implementation documentation, workflows, requirements, and customer-facing project materials.  
  • Coordinate testing, validation, issue resolution, rollout readiness, and go-live activities.  
  • Troubleshoot implementation blockers and coordinate internal or external support when needed.  
  • Ensure clear communication across customer teams, internal teams, vendors, and technical stakeholders.  
  • Support onboarding, user adoption, training coordination, and operational transition.  
  • Maintain disciplined project governance in environments with strict documentation, approval, and risk requirements.  
  • Support process improvement and standardization of implementation practices.  


Required Experience

  • Direct experience implementing software or operational systems for nuclear power generation customers is required. 
  • Experience managing technical, operational, infrastructure, engineering, or software implementation projects.  
  • Experience implementing software platforms, SaaS solutions, enterprise systems, maintenance systems, operational systems, or digital workflow solutions within nuclear power generation environments. 
  • Familiarity with common nuclear operations and maintenance systems, terminology, and workflows.  
  • Customer-facing project or implementation management experience.  
  • Strong stakeholder management across technical, operational, and executive audiences.  
  • Experience coordinating implementation documentation, project plans, timelines, risk logs, status reports, and handover materials.  
  • Experience supporting testing, rollout, deployment, commissioning, validation, or go-live activities.  
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.  
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, remote environment.  
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.  
  • Brazil-based or authorized to work from Brazil for this customer environment.  


Preferred Experience


  • Experience with systems such as IBM Maximo or similar enterprise asset management platforms is highly preferred. 
  • Experience implementing SaaS, enterprise software, operational systems, infrastructure systems, telecom systems, engineering systems, or project control platforms.  
  • Experience with U.S.-based customers or multinational stakeholders.  
  • Experience in highly regulated, safety-sensitive, or mission-critical environments.  
  • Familiarity with nuclear project documentation, approval workflows, testing discipline, operational restrictions, or regulated handover processes.  
  • Experience with change management, user adoption, customer onboarding, or operational rollout.  
  • Background in engineering, IT, telecom, infrastructure, industrial operations, project controls, or energy-related environments.  
  • Strong candidates may come from consulting, software implementation, or professional services organizations supporting nuclear energy customers.

This isn’t one of them.

Why it’s a good move:


If you’ve worked on editor-like or collaboration-heavy products before, this is a rare opportunity to go deeper on:


  • real-time systems
  • complex UI architecture
  • AI-native product design


…and do it in a setting where your work actually defines the product.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

Estamos em busca de um(a) Salesforce Solution Architect altamente qualificado(a) para liderar o desenho de soluções de ponta a ponta em implementações, melhorias e integrações na plataforma Salesforce.

Esse(a) profissional atuará como autoridade técnica, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance, alinhadas às melhores práticas e ao roadmap da Salesforce.

O perfil ideal combina forte conhecimento técnico hands-on com visão estratégica, excelente comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa ao longo do ciclo de entrega.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenho de soluções de ponta a ponta para implementações, melhorias e integrações Salesforce
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em arquitetura técnica, modelos de dados e desenho de soluções
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de integração e modelos de segurança
  • Atuar como autoridade técnica nas diferentes clouds Salesforce (Sales, Service, Experience, etc.)
  • Orientar times de desenvolvimento sobre boas práticas, padrões de design e limites da plataforma
  • Garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas ao roadmap da Salesforce
  • Participar de workshops de discovery, revisões de solução e decisões técnicas
  • Identificar riscos, restrições e trade-offs antecipadamente e propor estratégias de mitigação
  • Apoiar estimativas, dimensionamento de soluções e atividades de pré-venda quando necessário
  • Colaborar com Product Owners, BAs, Desenvolvedores e QA ao longo de todo o ciclo de entrega


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Solution Architect ou Technical Architect em projetos Salesforce
  • Forte conhecimento prático em:
  • Sales Cloud e Service Cloud
  • Modelagem de dados e arquitetura de compartilhamento/segurança
  • Ferramentas de automação (Flows, Apex, Validation Rules)
  • Padrões de integração (REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Middleware)
  • Experiência no desenho de soluções multi-cloud e de nível enterprise
  • Sólido entendimento dos limites da plataforma, performance e governança
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos
  • Capacidade de liderar discussões técnicas e influenciar decisões arquiteturais

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market.


As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series.


The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks.


Key Responsibilities


1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction

  • Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners.
  • Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery.
  • Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals.
  • Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.

2. Promo Creation & Localization

  • Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series.
  • Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences.
  • Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.

3. Production & Quality Control

  • Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery.
  • Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output.
  • Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives.
  • Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.

4. Dubbing Agency Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production.
  • Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery.
  • Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit.
  • Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.

5. Performance Reworks & Optimization

  • Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues.
  • Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance.
  • Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals.
  • Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles.
  • Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.

6. Process, Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered.
  • Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset.
  • Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders.
  • Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.

7. AI Tool Adoption

  • Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement.
  • Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.
  • Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production.
  • Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.

8. Market & Audience Understanding

  • Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends.
  • Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences.
  • Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.


Qualifications


  • Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production.
  • Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement.
  • Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors.
  • Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances.
  • Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors.
  • Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement.
  • Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes.
  • Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation.
  • Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.


Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale.

They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estágiário | Analista | Consultor em Estratégia & Desenvolvimento em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Muito além de uma consultoria, somos um ecossistema de soluções em gestão e estruturação de negócios que transformarão o futuro do turismo. Temos 4 grupos de soluções para as áreas de hospitalidade, entretenimento e destinos turísticos: 


  • Estratégia & Desenvolvimento: Estruturação e viabilidade de novos negócios; 
  • Operação & Performance: Asset Management, eficiência operacional e novas receitas 
  • Revenue Management & Analytics: inteligência de mercado e análise de tendências; 
  • Produto & Inovação: Novos produtos, marcas e experiências. 


Assim como a coruja, que inspirou o nosso nome, utilizamos nossa sabedoria e visão aguçada para alçar voos cada vez mais altos. Trabalhamos com verdade e nos envolvemos em projetos em que acreditamos, pois sabemos que o êxito é maior quando alinhamos interesses com todos que caminham com a gente.

Aqui, prezamos por um ambiente de trabalho leve, flexível, ético, inovador, íntegro e que valoriza a autonomia de cada colaborador. Todas as opiniões e sugestões são muito bem-vindas e respeitadas. Buscamos quem partilha desses princípios e acredita ser possível fazer diferente e ir além.

O SEU DIA A DIA COM A GENTE  

  • Atuação em projetos de viabilidade econômica, valuations, planos de negócio, planejamento estratégico e planos de expansões nas áreas de hospitalidade e entretenimento; 
  • Participação na elaboração de nossos estudos setoriais; 
  • Envolvimento na estruturação, implantação e concepção de negócios do setor; 
  • Organização e participação em viagens de campo (quando possível); 
  • Análise de indicadores e pesquisas de benchmarking; 
  • Local de trabalho: remoto. Possibilidade de encontros presenciais em São Paulo (capital) de acordo com a disponibilidade do colaborador. 

PERFIL DO CANDIDATO  

  • Formado ou cursando hotelaria, turismo, administração, economia ou áreas correlatas e, o mais importante, se interessar pelos setores em que atuamos; 
  • Raciocínio lógico, boa capacidade analítica e excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita; 
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender; 
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes; 
  • Inglês avançado; 
  • Desejável conhecimento das ferramentas Microsoft Excel e Power Point. 

BENEFÍCIOS  

  • Salário de acordo com a vaga;
  • Bônus por desempenho (para analista e consultor);
  • Seguro de vida; 
  • Vale refeição; 
  • Auxílio transporte; 
  • Treinamentos de capacitação com materiais de aulas ministradas em cursos de pós-graduação.

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado] em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a Project Manager to serve as the operational backbone of client delivery, coordinating workflows across creative, media, and retention teams. You will be responsible for managing project timelines, organizing resources, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams and clients to maintain the high standard of service our partners expect.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of client deliverables and campaign launches
  • Streamlined workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and improve team velocity
  • High client satisfaction scores through proactive communication and organized project management
  • Well-documented processes that scale efficiently as the team and client base grow


Responsibilities

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Coordinate between creative, media buying, retention, and account teams to allocate resources effectively
  • Organize weekly client meeting agendas, take detailed notes, and create actionable task lists from meeting outcomes
  • Create and assign Asana tasks for internal teams based on client requests and monthly retainer deliverables
  • Track creative production pipelines and monitor asset status from brief through completion
  • Build and maintain SOPs for internal processes, organized in Notion
  • Set up and manage client project management tools including Google Drive, Asana, Slack, and creative proofing platforms
  • Lead internal team standups and coordinate cross-functional project kickoffs
  • Handle client onboarding processes and schedule kick-off calls with appropriate stakeholders
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and proactively implement process improvements
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of scope of work for each client account
  • Keep all project stakeholders aligned and informed to ensure client retention and satisfaction


Requirements

  • 4+ years of project management experience in a digital marketing or agency environment
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and digital advertising (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, email marketing)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with clients and internal teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Expert proficiency with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools (Asana, Notion, Slack)
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaborative team relationships


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a digital advertising or eCommerce agency
  • Familiarity with creative production workflows and asset management
  • Experience with Figma, Frame.io, or other creative collaboration tools
  • Background in managing subscription-based or retainer client relationships
  • Process documentation and SOP development experience


Compensation and Benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan : Fully customizable 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Wellness Benefits : Complimentary Headspace subscription and fitness stipend
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Technology Supplied : Equipped with the latest laptop and necessary tools for success
  • Professional Development : Opportunities for growth, training, and expanded responsibilities
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, 6 month contract (PJ model) and salary range is 25-30/hr USD.


Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer
  • Experience with Python and Bash – shell script wrappers and python building data pipelines
  • Working with big data, making sure it is optimized
  • Airflow experience for orchestration
  • Snowflake DB experience/RedShift
  • Terraform experience, AWS – S3, SQS
  • SQL – adhoc queries and SQL for data pipelines


Plusses:

  • AI for generating code – Claude, CodeX, Copilot
  • Streaming and batch experience – spark, Kafka


The Search and AI Platform is our client's agentic data platform which powers products and their next-generation LLM-powered research systems.


The platform uses agentic services to interrogate our rich knowledge graphs, search and recommendation systems, and our unparalleled collection of research data to deliver insights to the scientific community so they can collaborate more effectively, work smarter, and deliver quality research more quickly.


We’re looking for an innovative, passionate Senior Data Engineer I to be the senior data engineer on the new AI Content team to help design, build and maintain scalable pipelines to ingest content to a centralized content storage system, to help build and maintain a scalable content enrichment and retrieval system, as well as pipelines to load content search indexes. The newly built systems are in early-stage implementation, and we are giving this team remit to ingest massive amounts of content, which supports AI-powered products across the organization.


You will be

  • Designing, prototyping, and building robust and scalable pipelines using AI-assisted, spec-driven development, following clean code and best-practice software engineering principles
  • Working with technologies including Python (FastAPI), Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, Iceberg, Kafka and RDBMS
  • Building cloud infrastructure in AWS to host and monitor the services, automating common tasks mercilessly

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Pleno | Python, PySpark, Kafka e Dados em Tempo Real
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro(a) de Dados Pleno | Python, PySpark, Kafka e Dados em Tempo Real em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No entretenimento digital, segundos importam. Pagamentos que travam custam caro.

A LBPay nasceu para eliminar esse problema. Como Instituição de Pagamento autorizada pelo Banco Central, atuamos em ambientes de alta exigência como iGaming, e-commerce e operações de alta frequência — onde estabilidade, velocidade e confiabilidade são inegociáveis.


Sobre a posição

Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados, desenvolvendo pipelines escaláveis e garantindo a disponibilidade de informações críticas para o negócio.


Você trabalhará com grandes volumes de dados transacionais, contribuindo para a qualidade, confiabilidade e performance das soluções que apoiam áreas estratégicas da empresa. Procuramos alguém com perfil hands-on, senso de ownership e interesse em atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais de engenharia de dados e alto impacto no negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Python, PySpark e SQL.
  • Construir e evoluir fluxos de ingestão de dados baseados em eventos e streaming.
  • Implementar transformações, deduplicação e tratamento de dados nas camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados processados.
  • Criar e otimizar tabelas e visões analíticas para consumo por dashboards e aplicações de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com armazenamento em Parquet e ambientes S3-compatible.
  • Participar da evolução de schemas e contratos de dados entre sistemas produtores e consumidores.
  • Desenvolver testes automatizados e mecanismos de validação para proteção de indicadores financeiros.
  • Monitorar pipelines e investigar inconsistências ou discrepâncias de dados.
  • Apoiar implantações e operação de soluções em Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Compliance, Tesouraria e Tecnologia na construção de soluções orientadas a dados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática atuando como Engenheiro(a) de Dados ou em funções equivalentes.
  • Domínio de Python aplicado à engenharia de dados.
  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL avançado.
  • Experiência com Apache Spark / PySpark para processamento e transformação de dados.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas de dados em camadas (Bronze, Silver e Gold).
  • Experiência trabalhando com arquivos Parquet e armazenamento em nuvem ou object storage.
  • Conhecimento de Docker e noções práticas de Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados, versionamento Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com mensageria e streaming de dados, especialmente Kafka ou tecnologias similares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Apache Pulsar.
  • Conhecimento de DuckDB e PostgreSQL para workloads analíticos.
  • Conhecimento sobre PIX, Open Finance, SPI, MED ou regulamentações do BACEN.
  • Experiência com observabilidade utilizando Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana ou Metabase.
  • Conhecimento em GitOps, ArgoCD, Helm ou Kustomize.
  • Experiência com Protobuf e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.


Detalhes da vaga:

Modalidade: Remoto

Contratação: PJ


O que oferecemos?

TotalPass – sua saúde física é importante!

Day off de aniversário

title: Senior Backend Engineer (PHP&Laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (PHP&Laravel) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Tech Lead | TypeScript | Node.js | Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead | TypeScript | Node.js | Remote em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa inovadora do segmento de georastreamento e rastreamento inteligente , que utiliza tecnologia para gerar insights estratégicos através de dados de localização em tempo real.

Buscamos um(a) Engineering Tech Lead com perfil hands-on , que combine excelência técnica com capacidade de liderança, atuando diretamente no desenvolvimento e na evolução de um produto altamente escalável e orientado a dados.


Sobre a posição:


Essa posição tem um equilíbrio entre desenvolvimento (50%) e liderança (50%) , sendo ideal para alguém que gosta de codar, tomar decisões técnicas e desenvolver pessoas ao mesmo tempo .

Você liderará um time ágil multidisciplinar, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade enquanto contribui ativamente com o código e a arquitetura das soluções.

A posição é 100% remota e o modelo de contrato é CLT. Inglês é essencial, pois a comunicação será com times internacionais .


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis utilizando Node.js e TypeScript
  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura de sistemas (microserviços e integrações)
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos
  • Assegurar performance, confiabilidade e segurança das aplicações
  • Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver engenheiros
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (Scrum)
  • Gerenciar backlog, priorização e definição de histórias
  • Garantir entregas dentro do prazo e com qualidade
  • Balancear evolução do produto com gestão de dívida técnica


O que esperamos desse profissional:


  • Perfil hands-on , com forte atuação em código
  • Capacidade de liderar pelo exemplo
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e de alta velocidade
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio
  • Visão de produto aliada à execução técnica
  • Forte experiência com Node.js e TypeScript
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços
  • Vivência com AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com Scrum/Agile
  • Sólida base em system design e escalabilidade
  • Experiência prévia liderando ou mentorando times


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em frontend moderno (React, Angular)
  • Experiência com Ruby on Rails
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, etc.)
  • Experiência em ambientes de alto crescimento (startups/scale-ups)


Experiência:

title: Client Services Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Services Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant

Remote, Latin America


Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.


We’re hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.


This is not a “wait for instructions” role. It’s for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.


You’ll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.


If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what’s missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.


What You’ll Own -----------


Client Services Operations


This is the center of the role.


You’ll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, HubSpot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.


You’ll also help catch what’s slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.


The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.


Pipeline + Relationship Tracking


You’ll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.


You won’t be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You’ll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.


Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination


You’ll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.


That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.


You won’t own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.


This Role Is a Fit If You:


• Notice gaps and communicate them early

• Take ownership without needing to be chased

• Track details carefully and follow through completely

• Ask smart questions, then remember the answer

• Can support a busy team without adding noise

• Stay calm when priorities shift

• Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful


This Role Is Not a Fit If You:


• Need detailed instructions for every task

• Wait to be told what to do next

• See problems but don’t speak up

• Think “done” means “mostly handled”

• Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented


Requirements


• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and verbal English

• High ownership and follow-through

• Strong attention to detail

• Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern SaaS systems

• Fast, stable internet connection

• Professional presence on video


Tools may include ClickUp, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.


Work Setup


Remote, Latin America preferred

Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours

Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)


How to Apply


We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.


If shortlisted, we will ask that you submit:


• Your resume

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you

• Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work


We will follow up with a final list of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.


We’re looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.


If you’re the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Auditor – Licensing & Compliance (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  


At Simplify CCS, we specialize in innovative contract compliance audits that deliver real value to our clients. Our work supports companies in safeguarding their strategic relationships with vendors, customers, and partners. Since 2014, we've combined expertise in audits, data analytics, and risk management to provide world-class Strategic Contract Risk Management Solutions. 


Headquartered in USA, with a presence in LATAM and EMEA, Simplify serves a global clientele, growing exponentially for over 10 years because our clients understand and appreciate our approach to compliance testing through data analysis, delivered by our team of well trained and motivated subject matter experts. We are a growing international company, and we’re excited to expand our presence in Latin America—starting with you. 


Our purpose: Detect the Unseen. Defend Fairness. Deliver Trust. 


Your Role & Responsibilities 


You’ll play a key role in owning and executing audit engagements, ensuring compliance with internal controls and external standards, and contributing directly to client-facing work. This is a senior individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities although with responsibility for mentoring, guiding, and reviewing the work of junior auditors 


We are hiring for one experienced audit professional with approximately 5–6+ years of relevant audit experience who is comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving environment. 


Your main areas of impact: 


  • Lead Licensing Audit Engagements: Take ownership of reviewing and analyzing licensing agreements, contracts, and large datasets to assess compliance and identify potential financial recovery opportunities. 
  • Advanced Data Analysis & Testing: Design and execute audit test plans, independently analyze client data, identify anomalies, and quantify discrepancies with minimal oversight. 
  • Client-Facing Reporting & Insights: Draft clear, well-structured audit reports that communicate key findings, root causes, and practical recommendations to improve client governance and contract compliance. 
  • Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and global team members, proactively sharing progress, risks, and insights to ensure audits are delivered on time and to a high standard. 
  • Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to improving audit methodologies, templates, and internal processes. Support internal initiatives such as training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. 


✅ What You Bring 


  • You hold a degree in Accounting, or Finance and are eager to apply your knowledge in real-world audit scenarios; professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA, ACCA) are a plus 
  • 5–6+ years of experience in Contract Compliance auditing and/or Forensic Accounting within professional services; experience in the licensing industry is plus.
  • Expert in Excel and familiar with data tools such as Power BI and similar. 
  • English Level Advanced (C1/C2 Required). 
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled to identify risks, patterns and inconsistencies within contracts and large datasets. 
  • Proactive Team player, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and working hours. 
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex audit findings and present insights to stakeholders with confidence and impact. 
  • Ability to mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance, feedback, and ongoing support. 


What We Offer (LATAM - Remote) 


  • Fully Remote Setup 
  • Flexible Hours: Adapt your work schedule to fit your rhythm—coordinate global projects without overtime overload (mostly following EST time zone).  
  • Paid learning: Access to language courses, online platforms, professional certifications all tailored to your personal and career goals. 
  • Competitive USD compensation 
  • Team Culture: Join a diverse, supportive team that values open communication, transparency, and collaboration. 
  • Global Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with international clients across LATAM, EMEA, and North America. 
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 26 days of paid vacation each year to rest, recharge, and come back inspired. 
  • Fully Equipped for Success: We’ll provide all the equipment you need — from laptops to accessories — so you can do your best work from anywhere. 
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Your well-being matters. We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally. 


We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done. 


⏰ Recruitment Process 


  • Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn. 
  • Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience. 
  • Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions. 
  • Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study. 
  • Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit. 
  • Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!
