● Iniciativa, vontade de aprender e capacidade de atuar de forma independente em um ambiente dinâmico.

● Graduação em Seguros, Administração, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.

● Conhecimento em planilhas (Excel ou Google Sheets).

title: IT Support Engineer (M365 & Azure)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para IT Support Engineer (M365 & Azure) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a \"IT Support Engineer \" for our client, a top service provider renowned for trading and refurbishing used technology, such as cellphones and laptops. This company is dedicated to assisting manufacturers with sustainable practices and plays a significant role in reducing new tech expenses on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


• To provide operational support across Alchemy’s estate of devices, network infrastructure,

and end user computing related cloud services including health checks and reporting.

• Diagnose and resolve faults in physical and cloud-based services and infrastructure supported

by the Technical Operations team

• Take ownership of configuring and maintaining Alchemy’s Physical and virtual network

infrastructure, including LAN, WAN and Telephony

• Maintain the Security integrity of the Technical Operations service portfolio including

patching, automated vulnerability assessments, Firewalls, software Security suites and MDM

• Proactively educate Alchemists, instilling a security first mindset through the use of our

automated phishing and exploit awareness toolsets

• Support Alchemists in become as self-sufficient as possible by providing self-service tools, and

creating knowledge base articles to improve incident and event resolution efficiency

• Managing incidents, problems, requests and changes in line with ITIL best practice and

ensuring that SLA's are maintained

• Act as a cross-media Point of Resolution for all Support Engineering related issues

• Analyse and measure your services to develop, communicate and action continual process and

technology improvements

• Work without continuous supervision and be trusted to provide professional support services

to your fellow Alchemists

Alchemists

accreditations

Applications. Should any occur, immediately respond effectively to and contain those IT

including the creation of associated documentation

• Setting up new sites and locations as required

• Ensure all logs for equipment and users are maintained

• Providing support to Alcehmists whether remotely or in person

Your Behaviors:

• Communicator – You can make yourself concisely and clearly understood through positive

interactions with people across all levels of Alchemy regardless of their seniority, geography

and culture

• People Focused – You understand that people make Alchemy a success

• Lifelong Learner – Everyday is a chance to discover/teach something new

levels

independently

• Reliable - You’re the person stakeholders and peers always want to work with, remaining

visible as the face of IT to listen to concerns and share as needed

• Professional – It’s never personal, you understand what is happening from the end users

perspective

• Presentable – You don’t need suits and ties to inspire confidence, we do so through our

smart casual appearance

• Compassionate – You understand that people in need require careful attention

• Energetic - You bring bags of energy every day, the only way is forward

• Organised - You are detail oriented and manage your time and the time of others well

• Data driven – Information is your friend; you love to use facts and evidence to help ensure

success for the team and our customer


Qualifications, Knowledge & Experince

Essential:

• A high degree of technical knowledge and competence

• Demonstrable ability to troubleshoot complex, technical, multi-site and multi-discipline

incidents and problems

and their associated security implementations

• At least 4 years hands on experience with Microsoft Azure technologies (Servers Active

Directory, DNS, Group Policy etc)

supporting a globally distributed organisation

Linux

• Practical deployment and administration experience of standard end-point security and Disk

Encryption tools

• Senior level experience of supporting standard software suites

• Demonstrable practical experience of management of Microsoft Exchange Online and email

services

and technologies (DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN etc) gained in a hands-on technical support role

• Hands-on experience of firewall and security appliance configuration and management

• Experience of working within the ITIL framework

• Practical experience of deploying and managing MDM services

• Excellent verbal and written English skills are essential

• Excellent working knowledge of Chrome, IE & Safari

• Experience of liaising with 3rd party suppliers

• A full driving licence is essential for this role

• Practical use of Service desk tools

• Practical experience of working in n teams across multiple geographies and timezones


Desirable:

• Experience of building laptops and desktops using automated/remote end point

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: AI Agent Builder & Automation Engineer
description:

Beige is looking for an exceptional, high-energy AI Agent Builder & Automation Engineer to join our technology team, architect cutting-edge automation ecosystems, and revolutionize our internal workflows and client-facing infrastructure.

This is not a traditional, slow-paced administrative or IT support role. You will operate as a critical driver of our company-wide digital transformation, taking extreme ownership of building custom AI agents, linking data pipelines, and eliminating manual operational bottlenecks for a rapidly growing media technology startup.

If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, possesses advanced technical skills across modern AI/LLM frameworks, and is obsessed with workflow efficiency and flawless automation logic, we want to hear from you.

About Beige

Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale.

Through Beige.app, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform.

We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content.

As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth.

Location & Schedule
  • Location: Remote (International / Global Talent)
  • Schedule: Must be fully available to operate, test, and collaborate during our standard business coverage hours (aligned with US Central Standard Time / Pacific Standard Time). Flexibility is required to deploy urgent solutions during platform rollout phases.
Compensation
  • 600/Month


What You'll Be Doing

  • Custom AI Agent Architecture: Design, build, test, and deploy intelligent, multi-turn AI agents tailored for specific department use cases (HR, Sales, Customer Support, and Production).
  • Workflow Automation Pipelines: Architect seamless integrations and robust automation workflows between external platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, CRMs, email) and internal infrastructure.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Craft complex system prompts, build conversational logic chains, and continually refine LLM context windows to reduce errors and ensure highly accurate outputs.
  • System Integration: Utilize modern API integrations and automation hubs to sync data across disparate platforms, completely eliminating repetitive manual data entry.
  • System Optimization & Maintenance: Audit existing team workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and maintain custom tools to keep systemic operational friction at absolute zero.
Who We're Looking For Required Qualifications:
  • Strong English Proficiency: High fluency in written and spoken English with exceptional technical and team communication skills.
  • Proven Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience building functional AI apps, custom bots, or comprehensive automation pipelines in a startup or fast-paced corporate environment.
  • Software & Logic Mastery: Expert-level fluency with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, Microsoft Power Automate) and conversational AI/LLM deployment tools (e.g., OpenAI API, Claude/Anthropic, custom agent frameworks).
  • Technical Hardware Setup: A reliable, high-speed internet connection, dedicated workstation, and a stable power backup/electricity supply to maintain uninterrupted development operations.
  • Project Portfolio: A comprehensive list, case studies, or working live demos of AI agents, bots, or automated systems you have custom-built and successfully deployed.
Preferred / Major Plus:
  • Base familiarity or coding proficiency in languages used for advanced integrations (Python, JavaScript/JSON, SQL).
  • Deep experience setting up custom CRM automated workflows and managing complex follow-up automation architecture.
  • Prior exposure to media production, marketplace apps, or creative agency environments.
Core Behavioral Expectations:

To succeed in this role, you must be obsessed with operational efficiency and logic. You need to welcome rapidly shifting technical requirements, accept constructive feedback with professionalism, and actively prefer building scalable, intelligent systems over band-aid, low-impact administrative routines.

title: Talent Acquisitions Specialist
description:

Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full time remote role for a Talent Acquisitions Specialist. The Talent Acquisitions Specialist will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and onboarding new employees. Additional tasks include maintaining employee records, providing onboarding administrative support, and supporting the development and implementation of HR initiatives. 


The position follows U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally Monday through Friday. Working hours will vary slightly throughout the year due to business needs but will typically align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST.


Qualifications

  • C1 or C2 level of English. Candidates below C1 level will not be considered . 
  • 3-8 years experience in recruitment, sourcing candidates, and conducting interviews
  • Skills in employee relations, HR policies, and labor law compliance
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • The ability to maintain clear, consistent communication with hiring managers and internal stakeholders regarding the status of active searches, candidate pipelines, timelines, and next steps.
  • Proficiency in HR software and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing channels simultaneously, including alternative platforms and outreach methods beyond traditional job boards.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

description:

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.
